title: Manager, Workday Integrations
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

We are seeking an experienced and hands-on Manager, Workday Integrations, who combines strong Workday technical expertise with functional knowledge. As a key member of the Global HRIS team, this role will be responsible for designing and developing new integrations, supporting and troubleshooting existing ones, and delivering related technical solutions across Core HCM, Payroll, Recruiting, Time Tracking, Compensation, and other modules. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong expertise in Workday integration tools and methodologies, partner with internal and external stakeholders, translate business requirements into scalable solutions, demonstrate end-to-end ownership and support the continued evolution of our HR technology landscape.

Remote position based in US, East Coast preferred

Essential Functions of the Job:

• Serve as the primary owner or subject matter expert for Workday integrations.

• Strong hands-on expertise with Workday integration tools such as Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, Payroll Connect (PECI/PICOF), Document Transformation, Workday Web Services, RaaS, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, XML, XSLT/XPath, Workday Studio, and Workday Query Language (WQL).

• Design, develop and support payroll integrations with payroll platforms such as ADP and Deel with a strong understanding of inbound and outbound payroll data requirements.

• Support the design and development of solutions using Workday Extend, Orchestrate, and other emerging Workday technologies.

• Lead HR technology projects from requirements gathering and solution design through development, testing, deployment, documentation, and post-production support.

• Perform hands-on troubleshooting of integration failures, data transformation issues, API and web service errors, security configuration issues, and integration performance problems.

• Configure and manage Workday security for integrations, including domains, business process security policies, and integration system user permissions (ISU and ISSGs).

• Create Complex Calculated fields and advanced custom reports in workday to support integration requirements and optimize data flows.

• Partner closely with HR, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, IT, and other stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into effective technology solutions.

• Create and maintain comprehensive integration documentation, including technical design specifications, process flows, test scripts and user guides to support operational continuity.

• Perform unit testing, system integration testing (SIT), and support UAT to ensure new and updated integrations meet functional and performance standards.

• Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve system controls, reduce manual work, and enhance the employee and manager experience.

• Keep abreast of Workday updates and new features related to integrations, evaluating their potential impact on current processes and recommending enhancements as applicable.

• Actively engage in technical discussions and integration-related activities, including but not limited to release management, incident resolution, root-cause analysis and ad-hoc projects.

• Support HR technology governance, data privacy, SOX, security, audit, and compliance requirements.

• Contribute to HR Technology roadmap and future initiatives related to platform evolution, integration, automation, analytics, and AI-enabled capabilities.

• Share technical knowledge and best practices with other HR Technology team members and help strengthen the team’s overall technical capability.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree and/or related experience required

• 5+ years of hands-on Workday integration development and system administration experience.

• 3+ years of with advanced Workday integration technologies including Cloud Connect for Third-Party Payroll (CCTPP), PECI/PICOF, Workday Studio and Business Process Framework.

• Extensive hands-on experience with Workday integration technologies, including Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), Core Connectors, Document Transformation (XSLT), Report Writer, Reports-as-a-Service (RaaS), Calculated Fields, Workday Web Services, SOAP/REST APIs, XML, XSLT/XPath, and Workday Query Language (WQL).

• Experience designing, developing, and supporting integrations between Workday and third-party platforms, including SAP, Deel, ServiceNow, learning management systems, financial systems, benefits platforms, identity management systems, and other HR technology vendors.

• Strong knowledge of Workday integration security, including Integration System Users (ISUs), security groups, domains, authentication, and API security.

• Experience in managing Workday HCM, with a strong familiarity with the Workday business process framework

• Proven experience in troubleshooting integration issues and conducting root cause analysis.

• Understanding of the software development lifecycle, including identifying business requirements, crafting creative technical solutions, integrating and implementing solutions, and providing system maintenance and support.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, documentation, and technical leadership skills.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Demonstrated ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively across HR, Payroll, HR Operations, IT, Security, Finance, vendors, and other cross-functional teams.

• Experience with BIRT and prism is a plus.

• Previous experience in a global organization or within the pharmaceutical industry is a plus.

Computer Skills:

• Strong working knowledge of HR systems and MS Office

• Intermediate / Advanced experience using MS Excel

• Relevant Workday certifications are a plus

title: Sales Representative (Locations - Ciudad de México, Monterrey, Guadalajara)
hiringOrg: BeOne Medicines Mexico S de RL de CV
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

EXPERIENCIA OBLIGATORIA: INDUSTRIA FARMACÉUTICA/BIOTECNOLOGÍA, ONCOLOGÍA/HEMATOLOGÍA

CIUDADES BASE: Ciudad de México, Monterrey, Guadalajara

Descripción general de la empresa:

BeOne, Ltd. (NASDAQ: ONC; HKEX: 06160) es una empresa de biotecnología global, en fase comercial y basada en la investigación, centrada en terapias contra el cáncer inmuno-oncológicas y con objetivos moleculares específicos. Con un equipo de más de 10.000 empleados en China, Estados Unidos (Cambridge, MA; Ridgefield Park, Nueva Jersey; Emeryville, CA y San Mateo, CA), Suiza, Australia, Brasil y México, BeOne está avanzando en un proyecto que consiste en nuevas moléculas pequeñas orales y anticuerpos monoclonales para el tratamiento del cáncer. BeOne está trabajando para crear soluciones combinadas destinadas a tener un impacto significativo y duradero en los pacientes con cáncer.

Descripción general de la posición:

Bajo la dirección del Business Unit Manager, esta persona será responsable de maximizar los productos de BeOne en el territorio asignado. En coordinación con el Área de Acceso implementa la estrategia comercial, generando demanda y desbloqueando barreras de acceso en el área, y es responsable de lograr objetivos de ventas definidos dentro de un presupuesto de gastos acordado en estrecha alineación y colaboración con las otras funciones. Además, apoya y asesora a los clientes de cuentas clave en el territorio de manera apreciativa, abierta y honesta.

Responsable de impulsar e implementar la estrategia comercial considerando las particularidades de cada actor con el objetivo de mejorar el recorrido del paciente y ampliar el acceso, contribuyendo a un sistema de salud sostenible al desbloquear barreras de acceso.

Funciones esenciales:

• Lograr las metas de ventas, KPIs de marca, metas financieras y objetivos de marketing.

• Implementar y ejecutar el plan de visitas médicas, alineado a la estrategia de marketing, que optimice la cobertura, frecuencia y secuencia a médicos, cuentas y tomadores de decisión para maximizar el acceso y las oportunidades de venta

• Alcanzar objetivos acordados de contacto, cobertura y frecuencia a través de diversos canales de comunicación.

• Desarrollar planes de negocios e implementar actividades relacionadas, como eventos para clientes, campañas de ventas y marketing, así como presentaciones de ventas necesarias para lograr los objetivos acordados.

• Mantener y mejorar el conocimiento del producto, la estrategia del producto, el posicionamiento y los mensajes clave.

• Garantizar la satisfacción y las mejores relaciones con el cliente. Garantizar la finalización precisa y oportuna de todos los informes requeridos.

• Contribuir positivamente al equipo de Ventas y Marketing a través de relaciones cooperativas y esfuerzos colaborativos para lograr los objetivos del equipo y de la empresa.

• Desarrollar relaciones duraderas basadas en la adición de valor a los actores clave del territorio asignado.

• Profundo conocimiento del sistema de salud en la región donde opera, considerando todos los actores institucionales, redes de atención, regulación, legislación y la interrelación existente entre estos.

• Identificar barreras de acceso y ser capaz de desbloquearlas, colaborando con partes clave de la organización BeOne para desarrollar soluciones personalizadas.

• Trabajar en asociación con todos los miembros del equipo en el campo, para recopilar información relevante y construir la estrategia comercial para garantizar que las propuestas comerciales estén alineadas con las necesidades de los clientes y pacientes.

• Desarrollar e involucrar una red de grupos de interés de manera ética y sostenible, tanto dentro de instituciones públicas como privadas.

title: Director, Global Microbiology Governance & Oversight
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Director, Global Microbiology Governance & Oversight ensures the safety, purity, and efficacy of biopharmaceutical products. This role oversees contamination control strategies, environmental monitoring programs, and microbial identification systems across manufacturing facilities. The Director will align laboratory operations with global regulatory standards to ensure continuous compliance and product safety.

Essential Functions of the Job:

• Provide global strategic leadership and governance for contamination control strategy across manufacturing sites, establishing standards and ensuring consistent implementation and regulatory compliance.

• Ensure all operations strictly adhere to FDA, EMA, cGMP, and USP/EP compendial standards; act as a subject matter expert during regulatory inspections and audits.

• Establish and maintain global microbiology standards and governance related to microbial limits testing, sterility testing, endotoxin testing, and bioburden assays for raw materials, in-process samples, and final drug products across manufacturing sites.

• Drive harmonization of microbiological practices across the global network.

• Provide technical leadership for complex or high-risk microbial investigations across sites, such as out-of-Specification (OOS) results, Environmental Monitoring excursions, and contamination events.  Lead root-cause analysis and implement effective Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA).

• Identify emerging microbiological and regulatory risks and translate them into global Quality standards.

• Build and lead a global microbiology community of practice or technical network.

• Provide strategic microbiology input to new facilities, technology transfers, major capital projects, and/or product introductions.

• Partner with Manufacturing, R&D, and Engineering to assess microbiological risks using appropriate risk-management methodologies during process changes and facility modifications.

• Lead new technology implementation and Operation Excellence (OE) projects.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

• Leadership through global influence, governance, expertise.

Computer Skills:

• Strong  proficiency with Microsoft 365 and relevant laboratory systems, including LIMS.

Other Qualifications:

• Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of aseptic processing, cleanroom qualification, environmental monitoring, and computerized laboratory systems (LIMS).

• Core Competencies: Strong analytical troubleshooting skills, rigorous attention to detail, and excellent technical writing skills for regulatory submissions and investigation reports.

Travel:

Education:

• Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of microbiology experience in a cGMP-regulated biopharmaceutical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment required

• Master’s degree and 7+ years of Biopharmaceutical experience preferred

title: Director, Direct-to-Customer (DTC) Innovation & Digital Health
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

BeOne Medicines is seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial Director / Senior Director, Direct-to-Customer (DTC) Innovation & Digital Health to lead the development and launch of innovative customer engagement experiences across the hematology portfolio, with an initial focus on follicular lymphoma (FL), marginal zone lymphoma (MZL), and Waldenström macroglobulinemia (WM).

The role translates hematology strategy and customer insights into integrated, end-to-end experiences, including digital campaigns, disease-state microsites, CRM journeys, content ecosystems, digital health solutions, and clinical-trial awareness initiatives. This highly visible, hands-on position requires the ability to move seamlessly between strategy and execution, build regulated digital experiences, coordinate internal and external partners, and turn ideas into market-facing solutions with speed and rigor.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Lead FL, MZL and WM customer experience launches

• Own the strategy, development, and launch of integrated customer experiences for FL, MZL, and WM, including disease-state microsites, campaigns, CRM journeys, and supporting digital experiences.

• Translate disease insights, treatment journeys, unmet needs, and portfolio priorities into engagement strategies for patients, caregivers, and healthcare professionals.

• Determine when experiences should be disease-specific versus modular or shared across hematologic malignancies.

• Establish launch roadmaps, milestones, dependencies, governance, and success measures from concept through approval, deployment, and optimization.

Build integrated campaigns and content ecosystems

• Lead development and activation of branded and unbranded digital campaigns across priority hematology indications.

• Develop customer-first strategies spanning paid media, search, social, AI-enabled channels, point-of-care channels, and emerging platforms.

• Partner with Brand and cross-functional stakeholders so DTC initiatives complement broader commercial strategy with clear ownership and governance.

• Oversee agency and external partner work from strategic brief through creative development, regulatory review, production, activation, and optimization.

• Apply continuous improvement based on customer behavior, channel performance, business priorities, and emerging market opportunities.

Lead CRM strategy and customer journeys

• Design and launch CRM journeys for FL, MZL, and WM, connecting site experiences, content, media, and opt-in engagement into cohesive longitudinal customer journeys.

• Define audience segmentation, journey logic, triggers, content requirements, and measurement plans with CRM, analytics, technology, privacy, and agency partners.

• Use first-party data and behavioral insights to progressively personalize engagement and improve content relevance.

• Help evolve CRM from standalone communications into an integrated capability connecting multiple patient and customer touchpoints.

Advance digital health innovation

• Identify and lead digital health enablements that improve patient and HCP experiences across the hematology journey.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and partners and rapidly translate promising concepts into testable pilots.

• Explore AI-enabled experiences, personalization, decision-support tools, and other technologies that reduce friction and improve access to relevant information.

• Build business cases and measurement frameworks for new capabilities, balancing innovation with feasibility, compliance, privacy, and scalability.

Support clinical-trial awareness and digital recruitment innovation

• Partner with Clinical Operations, Medical, R&D, and other stakeholders to develop digital clinical-trial awareness initiatives for priority hematology studies.

• Develop compliant approaches to increase awareness of actively recruiting trials among appropriate HCP and patient audiences.

• Explore opportunities to connect disease education, CRM, digital platforms, media, and trial-finding experiences.

• Establish practical measurement approaches, including engagement, search behavior, referral indicators, and downstream enrollment signals where feasible.

Drive cross-functional execution

• Serve as a connector across Commercial, Medical, Clinical Operations, Corporate Affairs, Legal, Regulatory/PRC, Analytics, Technology, Privacy, and external agencies.

• Navigate regulatory requirements associated with branded, unbranded, disease-awareness, and clinical-trial communications.

• Build strong partnerships with hematology Brand teams while identifying opportunities to test new approaches and accelerate execution.

• Provide clear recommendations to senior leaders, simplify complex decisions, and maintain momentum as priorities or inputs change.

• Act with a high degree of autonomy and ownership while escalating material business, regulatory, privacy, or operational risks appropriately.

Build a measurement and optimization discipline

• Define launch KPIs across awareness, engagement, CRM enrollment, journey progression, media performance, customer behavior, and business impact.

• Partner with Analytics to connect channel-level engagement to meaningful downstream customer behaviors wherever feasible.

• Use test-and-learn methodologies to identify effective audiences, messages, journeys, and channels and rapidly adjust programs based on results.

• Communicate performance, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.

Qualifications:

Required

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

• Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare marketing/customer-experience experience, with direct hematology experience required.

• Strong working knowledge of the hematology/oncology treatment landscape, with experience in B-cell malignancies strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience launching digital campaigns, websites or microsites, CRM programs, or integrated omnichannel experiences in a regulated healthcare environment.

• Experience taking complex initiatives from strategy through content development, regulatory/MLR or PRC review, production, launch, and optimization.

• Strong understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory, privacy, and compliance considerations affecting patient and HCP engagement.

• Demonstrated success in a fast-paced, highly dynamic environment with multiple simultaneous priorities and aggressive launch timelines.

• Exceptional cross-functional leadership, stakeholder-management, and agency-management skills.

• Strong strategic thinking coupled with a willingness to be hands-on in execution.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to simplify complex clinical, technical, and strategic information.

Preferred

• Direct experience in FL, MZL, WM, CLL/SLL, or related B-cell malignancies.

• Experience building patient disease-education platforms, digital patient communities, or HCP education ecosystems.

• CRM experience, ideally including Salesforce Marketing Cloud, patient journey design, segmentation, consent management, and personalization.

• Experience with HCP digital/point-of-care platforms, paid media, search, and social activation.

• Experience with digital health, AI-enabled customer experiences, or emerging healthcare technologies.

• Clinical-trial recruitment or clinical-trial awareness experience.

• Experience using analytics, experimentation, and customer-level data to optimize marketing or digital-health initiatives.

• Experience managing agencies, vendors, budgets, and multiple simultaneous workstreams.

Computer Skills:  CRM platforms (ideally Salesforce Marketing Cloud), digital campaign and microsite environments, analytics and measurement platforms, paid media/search/social channels, AI-enabled tools, and related healthcare technology platforms.

description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

General Description:

At BeOne, our Global Development Superhighway — our integrated, end-to-end, wholly internal development capability — is a cornerstone of our R&D vision. It brings together a unique set of internal cross-functional capabilities from across the globe needed for efficient delivery of clinical trials to develop impactful medicines to accelerate access to innovation for patients around the world.

We are now opening this same delivery engine to the world’s most promising external science. Through Superhighways partnerships, highly promising assets from leading biotech partners can access our development capabilities creating a true win-win ecosystem with the ultimate goal of helping more patients around the world. This is not a fee-for-service model; it is a bold new way to grow the company and expand what’s possible in oncology. This is a rare opportunity to help build something genuinely new — joining a high-caliber, agile team at the leading edge of clinical development innovation. If you are energized by building, by challenging the status quo, and by making a real impact on patients’ lives, this is where you belong.

Accountable for global study delivery within agreed timelines and budget with appropriate inspection readiness quality for studies within our partnership programs under the Clinical Superhighway.

Leads all aspects of assigned clinical study(ies).

Leads global cross-functional study team (including oversight of external partners) and acts as point of escalation for resolution of issues within assigned study(ies).

Ensures alignment of study goals with clinical operations and corporate goals and objectives.

Contributes to development of global tools and standards, leads the development of work instructions and SOPs as required.

This role helps deliver the partnership studies that run on our Clinical Superhighway, supporting seamless onboarding and high-quality execution of external partner projects in close partnership with the execution functions.

Essential Functions of the Job:

Cross-Functional Leadership

• Leads the global cross-functional study team effectively, ensures effective decision making, and acts as point of escalation for resolution of study related issues.

• Leads external vendors management involved in study delivery.

• Builds trust and relationship with regional subject matter experts and supports the delivery of their local study objectives.

• Collaborates with key stakeholders across the organization and provides regular updates on study progress to senior management as required.

• Represents the study team at internal meetings and leads the cross-functional Clinical Study Team (CST) meetings.

• Participates and presents at various topics of Clinical Study Management.

• Participates in Clinical Operations Process improvement initiative.

Planning and Execution

• Leads planning and management of the assigned clinical study(ies) from feasibility through closeout activities.

• Generates, manages, maintains, and communicates high quality study timelines and tracks progress towards these.

• Ensures that the clinical studies are operationally feasible along with Global Clinical Program Lead, oversees trial feasibility, trial allocation and site selection process across all regions.

• Ensures timely availability of high-quality study documents to allow study submission to regulatory authorities and ECs/IRBs.

• Provides oversight to study start up and site activation plans.

• Ensures study plans (eg project management plan, monitoring plan, Trial Master File plan, data monitoring plan, ...) are created, updated and distributed timely and implemented appropriately.

• Ensures study systems and tools are set up timely, correctly and are functioning properly. Ensures study level information is updated on an ongoing basis in all systems.

• Implements RBQM end-to-end processes on time within the allocated study (e.g., periodic reviews, centralized monitoring analyses, action items).

• Ensures relevant study specific training is developed and implemented and ensures training records are well documented and filed.

• Ensures Trial Master File for study is created, maintained and QC’d on a regular basis as per the study TMF QC plan.

• Collaborates closely with Global Clinical Supplies to forecast study drug and timely delivery of supplies to sites.

• Supports and as needed drives overall data cleaning timelines in close collaboration with Data Management and other stakeholders.

• Ensures planning and execution of the Clinical Study Report in collaboration with Medical Writing and relevant CST members.

Quality and Risk Management

• Monitors study activities to ensure compliance with the study protocol, SOPs, all study plans, ICH/GCP and all other relevant regulations.

• Regularly reviews and manages quality-related GCO metrics to be within acceptable limits.

• Ensures inspection readiness at any point in time throughout the study life cycle.

• Works with cross-functional study team to identify, interpret, and evaluate issues on the study and ensures corrective and preventative actions are implemented.

• Ensures senior management and other key stakeholders are informed of risks and challenges and ensures risk mitigation plans are put in place and implemented.

• Prepares team for quality assurance audits and inspections.

• Collaborates with CST members and other colleagues to ensure cross-team, site learnings, and best practices are shared.

• Leads improvements and partners with study team members to enhance the efficiency and the quality of the work performed on assigned studies.

• Leads development, optimization and review of work instructions and SOPs as required.

Budget and Resources

• Works with the sourcing team to select and manage study vendors, approving invoice payment throughout the study.

• Manages study budgets, including baseline budget evaluation, change control, study closure budget, presents study budget for senior management engagement.

• Adheres to clinical study budgeting processes and provides input to finance on budget accruals and forecasts.

• Identifies and manages study team resource needs and establishes contingency plans for key resources.

• Monitors Clinical Study Team resource utilization over the study life cycle.

• Ensures clinical studies at a project level are executed within endorsed time, quality, and cost parameters.

title: Senior Scientist, Synthetic & Molecular Biology
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

Candidates must be able to work onsite in San Carlos, California.

At BeOne Institute, we extend BeOne’s execution strength with a dedicated innovation engine, bringing agility and scientific depth to transform uncertainty into actionable and high-impact therapeutic opportunities. We operate according to three core principles:

• Bold Exploration: we pursue novel and high-potential ideas through rapid, iterative innovation cycles.

• Strategic Alignment: we prioritize disease areas that align closely with BeOne’s R&D priorities and long-term vision.

• Pipeline Impact: we translate insights into tangible assets and advance emerging platforms into impactful programs.

At BeOne Medicines, we challenge the status quo to develop first-in-class therapies. We are seeking a highly skilled and driven Senior Scientist with expertise in Molecular Biology and Synthetic Biology to join our early discovery group within our agile biotech ecosystem. In this role, you will design, build, and optimize the next-generation genetic payloads that drive our cell therapy and RNA medicine platforms. You will serve as a core molecular biology expert, designing everything from individual targeted constructs to high-throughput pooled libraries for pooled screens and circuit optimization.

While molecular biology is your primary core capability, you will work iteratively with cell biologists, immunologists, and cross-functional project teams to ideate and rapidly advance lead constructs from in silico concept to in vitro functional validation.

Essential Functions of the Job:

• Proactively propose and implement innovative synthetic biology strategies (e.g., gene circuits, inducible promoters, dual-vector logic, novel cell-surface receptors) to address therapeutic hurdles in oncology and immunology.

title: Biotechnician I
hiringOrg: BeOne Medicines US Manufacturing Co., Inc.
description:
BeOne continues to grow at a rapid pace with challenging and exciting opportunities for experienced professionals. When considering candidates, we look for scientific and business professionals who are highly motivated, collaborative, and most importantly, share our passionate interest in fighting cancer.

The Biotechnician I position will directly support the startup phase of the Hopewell manufacturing facility and then shift focus to hands-on execution and support of cGMP manufacturing operations.

Facility Start-Up:

• Focused on related activities required to design, build, commission, and license BeOne’s first biopharmaceutical plant in the United States.

Essential Functions of the Job: include but not limited to:

• Design review

• Equipment selection, procurement and testing

• Protocol development and execution

• Acceptance testing and equipment/automation debugging

• Technical training

Hands-On cGMP Operations:

Focused on execution of cGMP manufacturing activities required to deliver the production plan reliably and compliantly.

• Follow cGMP procedures to support manufacturing execution and automated recipes

• Media preparation & transfers / filtration

• Cell culture sampling, monitoring & transferring

• Harvest operations

• Buffer preparation & transfers / filtration

• Operational and cleaning of chromatography and filtration systems.

• Equipment & process troubleshooting

• Deviation identification, reporting, drafting, investigate closure

• Change control drafting, presenting, closure

• cGMP procedure development and optimization

• Requesting, staging, and verifying materials for production activities

• Setup and preparation of equipment for formulation and filling

• Final filtration and formulation of drug product

• Aseptic filling of vials inside a Grade A isolator using automated filling equipment

• Performing in-process visual inspection for quality assurance

• Labeling and packaging of finished drug product in compliance with cGMP

• Completing batch documentation and reviewing records for accuracy

• Supporting routine cleanroom operations, equipment sanitization, and environmental monitoring

• Assisting in deviation investigations and participating in CAPA implementation as needed

• Operation of Distributed Computer System (DSC)

• Operation of equipment’s such as Clean-in-Place (CIP), Steam-in-Place (SIP) skid, Caustic skid, autoclave, part washer, filter integrity tester, biowelders, etc.

• Operation of SoloVPE protein concentration analyzer

• Cleaning of the facility

• Collection of samples for environmental monitoring

• Removal of process waste

Leadership Skills:

• Support supervisor managing day to day activities, including staff availability and task load

• Self-directed leadership within both predicable and ambiguous work environments

• Thoughtfully escalates issues/concerns in a timely manner as appropriate

Physical Requirements:

• Must be able to stand for long periods, up to 8 to 10 hours/day.

• Must be able to reach above shoulder level, bend/stoop, push/pull, and handle/grip frequently.

• Must be able to work scheduled 40 hours with the ability to work overtime as needed.

• Must be comfortable in working in varying temperatures.

• Frequent lifting, pushing, pulling, and carrying.  Ability to lift to 40 lbs.

• Regular reaching, bending, stooping, and twisting.

• Repetitive motion and substantial movement of the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.

• Environment requires dedicated gowns, depending on area.

• Work with hazardous materials and chemicals.

• Willing to work any shift.

Education Required:

• High school education or GED required.

• AS/BS/BA in science related field, biopharmaceutical or equivalent technical experience preferred.

Computer Skills:

• Familiarity with computer-based systems.  Word, Excel, and PowerPoint a must.

Other Qualifications:

• Evidence of good verbal and written communication.

• Ability to work in fast paced dynamic environment with competing priorities.

• Demonstrated ability to collaborate within and between diverse groups.

• Proactive identification and implementation of continuous improvement opportunities.

• Aptitude for learning moderately complex technical systems.

• Able to receive and incorporate feedback – passion for ongoing professional development a plus.

Travel:

• International and domestic as required

Global Competencies

When we exhibit our values of Patients First, Driving Excellence, Bold Ingenuity and Collaborative Spirit, through our twelve global competencies below, we help get more affordable medicines to more patients around the world.

• Fosters Teamwork

• Provides and Solicits Honest and Actionable Feedback

• Acts Inclusively

• Demonstrates Initiative

• Entrepreneurial Mindset

• Continuous Learning

• Embraces Change

• Results-Oriented

• Analytical Thinking/Data Analysis

• Financial Excellence

• Communicates with Clarity
